description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including signup and login endpoints. It handles creating new users with hashed passwords, validating login credentials, and generating JWT tokens for authenticated sessions.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user entity with fields such as name, email, phone, and password hash.

methods.name: AuthResponse signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by validating data, ensuring email uniqueness, hashing passwords, saving the user to the database, and returning an authentication token.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user authentication by verifying email and password, and returning a JWT token if credentials are valid.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/
